macros.name: boxedskills
macros.doc: The \boxedskills command uses another mechanism: after triggering an \onlyskills, it puts a \fbox or a \parbox in a \fbox around the skills, depending on whether the latter are printed inline or in a margin.

macros.name: noboxedskills
macros.doc:
The commands 
obracketedskills, 
oboxedskills and 
otonlyskills are equivalent: they all return to the default of putting parentheses around the skills references.

macros.name: skillsinleftmargin
macros.doc: For two-sided documents, \skillsinmargin and \skillsinleftmargin print skills in the inner margin, while \skillsinrightmargin prints them in the outer margin.

envs.name: skillquestions
envs.doc: The skills declared as arguments to the skillquestions environment are global: they are not linked to any specific question in the exam, but are rather evaluated throughout the exam and will be flagged as such in the skills table (see subsection 2.4).
